name: The Rise of the Machines
summary: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania has found initials and a rank marking on the elemental shards, and the machines you brought down in the Burning Steppes bore Rank IV. Theodora sends you with a shard sample to Lotwil Veriatus, a scholar of elemental sciences, in a camp to the east.

sections.title: Marks on the Shards
sections.body: The shards carry the initials G.L.A., with a rank marking beneath them. The machines you brought down in the Burning Steppes bore Rank IV, which Theodora assumes is a lowly rank. Theodora wants you to bring a sample shard to Lotwil Veriatus, renowned among scholars of elemental sciences. Lotwil is stationed at a camp to the east, and Theodora hopes Lotwil can help the search.

sections.title: What Lotwil Sees
sections.body: When you show Lotwil the shard, his face turns white. He knows these markings.

faq.q: Who sends you to Lotwil Veriatus?
faq.answer: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania, who wants Lotwil to look at a sample shard from the machines destroyed in the Burning Steppes.
In a camp to the east.

faq.q: What markings are on the elemental shards?
faq.answer: The shards bear the initials G.L.A., with a rank marking below. The destroyed machines were of Rank IV.

faq.q: Why does Theodora want Lotwil to inspect the shard?
faq.answer: Lotwil is renowned among scholars of elemental sciences, and Theodora hopes he can help with the search.
